description: Open the InsectSprays dataset in Jamovi (located at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/InsectSprays.csv'). Filter the data to include ONLY spray types 'C' and 'F'. Then, perform a Mann-Whitney U test (Independent Samples T-Test options) comparing 'count' (Dependent Variable) by 'spray' (Grouping Variable). Enable Group Descriptives in the analysis options. Save the results as 'InsectSprays_MannWhitney.omv' in the '~/Documents/Jamovi/' folder.
